model_annotation: The image presents two bar charts illustrating the distribution of one-syllable Chinese words in different literary genres, categorized by their grammatical function. The left chart, labeled (a) "各语体中支配动词的一级语义域分布" (Distribution of one-syllable governing verbs in different genres), shows the frequency of such verbs across five genres: 新闻 (News), 传统文学 (Traditional Literature), 网络小说 (Online Novels), 微信 (WeChat), and 微博 (Weibo). The bars are stacked, with the lower portion representing the frequency of the verb "说" (say/tell) and the upper portion representing the frequency of the verb "看" (see/look). The total frequency for each genre is displayed at the top of the bar. The frequencies are: News (4487, with 36% "说"), Traditional Literature (100, with 63% "说"), Online Novels (1002, with 83% "说"), WeChat (1962, with 93% "说"), and Weibo (4732, with 95% "说"). The right chart, labeled (b) "各语体中承受动词的一级语义域分布" (Distribution of one-syllable receiving verbs in different genres), shows the frequency of such verbs across the same five genres. The bars are also stacked, with the lower portion representing the verb "听" (hear) and the upper portion representing the verb "看" (see/look). The total frequency for each genre is displayed at the top of the bar. The frequencies are: News (10, with 90% "听"), Traditional Literature (100, with 90% "听"), Online Novels (666, with 90% "听"), WeChat (345, with 90% "听"), and Weibo (6126, with 90% "听"). Both charts use a vertical axis labeled "频次" (Frequency) with a scale from 0 to 7000, and the genres are listed on the horizontal axis. The legend on the right of the second chart identifies the colors corresponding to different verbs.
